chosen.label: CastingAnnouncement
chosen.definition: An event announcing the casting of a person in a role for a film, TV show, or theatrical production.
chosen.justification: No schema.org event type captures casting announcements; this is a specific media/entertainment industry event.

examples: Ryan Gosling joins MCU as Ghost Rider

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: ScreeningEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving the public showing of a movie or other video content. Also called film screening, movie showing, video presentation, cinema event. Examples: a film festival screening, a premiere showing of a new movie, a public documentary viewing, a drive-in movie night.

candidates.label: UserCheckins
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of checking into a location or event. Also called user check-in, location check-in, event attendance. Examples: a user checking into a restaurant, checking into a concert, marking attendance at a conference.

candidates.label: TheaterEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing a live performance in a theater. Also called stage play, theatrical show, drama performance. Examples: a Broadway musical, a local community play, a Shakespearean tragedy.

candidates.label: UserInteraction
candidates.comment: An outdated general type representing any interaction a user has with a web page or content. Also called user activity, user engagement, web interaction. Examples: a user clicking a link, submitting a form, scrolling a page.

chosen.label: ConferenceEvent
chosen.justification: Comic-Con is a convention involving presentations and networking, matching schema.org's ConferenceEvent definition.

candidates.label: ComedyEvent
candidates.comment: An event featuring comedic performances or content. Also called stand-up show, humor performance, comedy festival. Examples: A stand-up comedy show, a sketch comedy performance, a comedy festival, an improv night. Distinct from Event, which is a general occurrence.

candidates.label: PublicationEvent
candidates.comment: A PublicationEvent is an Event corresponding to the publication of a CreativeWork, regardless of its type or delivery medium. Also called release event, publishing event. Examples: the release of a new book, the broadcast of a TV show, the online publication of an article, the launch of a new album.

candidates.label: ConferenceEvent
candidates.comment: An event specifically organized as a conference, typically involving presentations, discussions, and networking. Also called conference, convention, symposium, summit. Examples: A tech conference, an academic symposium, a business summit, a medical convention. Distinct from Event, which is a general occurrence.

candidates.label: DeliveryEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing the delivery of an item, typically a product or package. Also called Shipping event, package delivery, consignment event. Examples: A package arriving at its destination, a food delivery being completed, a furniture delivery appointment. Distinct from Order, which is the request for items, not the delivery itself.

candidates.label: BroadcastEvent
candidates.comment: A BroadcastEvent is a PublicationEvent representing an event that is transmitted over the air or online. Also called live broadcast, streamed event, televised event, radio broadcast. Examples: a live news report, a sports game broadcast, a concert livestream.

chosen.label: PublicationEvent
chosen.justification: A comic debut is a publication of a CreativeWork, aligning with schema.org's PublicationEvent definition.

examples: Ghost Rider comic book debut as Carter Slade
Ghost Rider comic book debut as Johnny Blaze

candidates.label: OnDemandEvent
candidates.comment: An OnDemandEvent, as a PublicationEvent, is a publication event where a program is available on-demand. Also called catch-up TV, podcast release, streaming event. Examples: a TV show episode available for streaming after broadcast, a podcast episode release, a movie available for rent online. Distinct from BroadcastEvent, which is a live or scheduled transmission.

candidates.label: ComedyEvent
candidates.comment: An event featuring comedic performances or content. Also called stand-up show, humor performance, comedy festival. Examples: A stand-up comedy show, a sketch comedy performance, a comedy festival, an improv night. Distinct from Event, which is a general occurrence.

candidates.label: PerformingArtsEvent
candidates.comment: A PerformingArtsEvent is an event featuring live performances of arts like music, theatre, dance, or acrobatics. Also called live performance, show, stage event. Examples: a Broadway play, a ballet performance, a circus show, a stand-up comedy act. Distinct from MusicEvent, which is specifically for music.

candidates.label: VisualArtsEvent
candidates.comment: An event related to visual arts, such as an exhibition, gallery opening, or art fair. Also called art exhibition, gallery event, visual art show. Examples: a painting exhibition, a sculpture display, a photography festival.
